fields.rationale: No data-access layer anticipates every database capability. Keeping parameter construction, command execution, and result materialization separable lets callers drop down to raw ADO.NET for specialized operations while still reusing the framework's mapping, configuration, and resilience primitives.
fields.statement: Remain a simple layer over ADO.NET, never a walled garden. Keep setting parameters, invoking queries, and collecting results as independent steps a developer can use, skip, or override individually — and always leave an escape hatch to raw ADO.NET for anything the framework doesn't cover.
fields.title: Stay a thin, composable layer over ADO.NET

sources.label: FAQ — amend functionality via raw ADO.NET; separable parameter/query/result steps
